---
title: "数据分析"
---

## 试验参与者基线特征（简化版）


```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)

set.seed(2026)

n_per_group <- 30
total_n <- n_per_group * 2

# 模拟数据（列名全部为英文）
data <- data.frame(
  patient_id = paste0("S", sprintf("%03d", 1:total_n)),
  group = rep(c("试验组", "对照组"), each = n_per_group),
  age = round(rnorm(total_n, mean = 55, sd = 12), 0),
  gender = sample(c("男", "女"), total_n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.6, 0.4))
)

# ----- 年龄汇总（均值±标准差） -----
age_summary <- data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    age_mean_sd = paste0(round(mean(age), 1), "±", round(sd(age), 1))
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = age_mean_sd) %>%
  mutate(变量 = "年龄 (均值±标准差)")

# ----- 性别汇总（例数+百分比） -----
gender_summary <- data %>%
  group_by(group, gender) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = round(count / sum(count) * 100, 1),
    display = paste0(count, " (", pct, "%)")
  ) %>%
  select(group, gender, display) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = display) %>%
  mutate(变量 = ifelse(gender == "男", "性别 - 男", "性别 - 女")) %>%
  select(-gender)

# ----- 合并并输出 -----
final_table <- bind_rows(age_summary, gender_summary) %>%
  select(变量, 试验组, 对照组)

kable(final_table, caption = "表1. 患者基线特征", align = "c")
```
